exposure: Standardized two-layer suturing technique for caesarean sections
cohort: Women with one previous caesarean section were examined.
finding: The study found a low prevalence (9.1%) of small uterine niches in the cohort, with excellent residual myometrial thickness and niche percentage on myometrial thickness in all three detected cases.
mod_finding: The standardized two-layer surgical technique used for caesarean section resulted in a low prevalence (9.1%) of small uterine niches with excellent residual myometrial thickness, suggesting its superiority in niche prevention compared to expected prevalence.
